reading.zh: 从左到右两组：descriptors 描述外观与背景特征，registry 维护身份注册表并做合并与分配；箭头表示描述子流向注册表判定。
reading.en: Left to right in two groups: descriptors describe appearance and background features, registry keeps the identity table and performs merging and assignment; arrows carry descriptors into the registry decision.
